question.text: Which of the following chemicals may be used to identify three unlabelled beakers containing conc.NaOH, conc.$\mathrm{H}_{2}\mathrm{SO}_{4}$ and water?

solution.text:
$\mathrm{NH}_{4} \mathrm{NO}_{3}$ will evolve $\mathrm{NH}_{3}$ pungent smelling gas with $\mathrm{NaOH}$.
- $\mathrm{NO}_{2}$ brown gas with $\operatorname{con} . \mathrm{H}_{2} \mathrm{SO}_{4}$
-  No reaction with water
Thus, $\mathrm{NH}_{4} \mathrm{NO}_{3}$ can be used to label all three beakers. 
(c) $\left(\mathrm{NH}_{4}\right)_{2} \mathrm{CO}_{3}$ will evolve pungent smelling gas $\mathrm{NH}_{3}$ with $\mathrm{NaOH}$
- Effervescence of $\mathrm{CO}_{2}$ gas with con. $\mathrm{H}_{2} \mathrm{SO}_{4}$
- No reaction with water.
Thus, $\left(\mathrm{NH}_{4}\right)_{2} \mathrm{CO}_{3}$ can be used to label all three beakers.
Thus, options $(a, c)$ are correct.
